text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPEN: INC-20260315-42 — elevated 504s on /v1/generate (us-west-2, hosted). Pager triggered for oncall-primary. Impact: some long-context requests failing. Alert link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-20260315-42

maria_g: I'm on the pager, looking at logs now. Seeing KV-cache pressure spikes and downstream timeouts to relay-embedder.

aj: I'm online and reachable. If you need me to take primary for the next 30m, I can.

maria_g: For context: error rate jumped ~6:45pm UTC, p95 latency spiked, autoscaler didn't react due to recent scaling limits. I'm going to increase pool size and temporarily shift traffic to model-quantized-compact.

maria_g: Running the scale-up now:
```
# scale up dedicated pool for us-west-2 inference
redwoodctl pool update --region us-west-2 --pool inference-dedicated --min 4 --desired 12
```

sylvia: FYI the runbook step for this lives here: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrashing. Quick snippet for traffic-split fallback:
```
redwoodctl routing set --service generate --region us-west-2 --policy weighted --weights model-quantized-compact=0.3,model-standard=0.7
```

charlie_ops: Customer impact note: we already have two paid customers reporting errors in #support. CS notified. Please capture affected customer IDs.

maria_g: Captured customer IDs: cust-1023, cust-1175. Logging their requests and tagging tickets.

incident-bot: Update: autoscaler job queued, expected apply in ~40s.

maria_g: Scale started. KV cache evictions reduced after core nodes came up. 504s dropping but some tail still failing. I'm going to hand primary to @aj — need to step away for an incident command call at 19:10 UTC. Leaving notes below.

maria_g: HANDOFF -> aj (primary). Notes:
- What I did: scaled dedicated pool, set temporary weighted routing to model-quantized-compact, increased connection timeouts on relay-embedder.
- What to watch: p95 latency generate, error rate /v1/generate, redis evictions (kv_cache_evictions metric).
- Known gaps: autoscaler respects per-customer quotas; one quota prevented full scale for cust-1175. Need a ticket to audit quota flow.
- Runbook pointers: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrashing (see section 'temporary routing and scale')

aj: Ack, taking primary. I'll monitor for 30m and follow up if we need escalation. Can you paste the exact command you used to increase timeouts?

maria_g: timeout change (relay-embedder):
```
kubectl -n relay set env deployment/relay-embedder REQUEST_TIMEOUT=20s
# was 10s
```

aj: Got it. I'm watching dashboards. p95 down from 1.8s -> 0.9s, error rate down 70%. :white_check_mark:

charlie_ops: Thanks. Can you open a post-incident ticket to track root cause, quotas, and a follow-up retro? I'll coordinate CS comms.

aj: Filing ticket now: https://tickets.redwood.internal/TKT-4521 (POST-INC: INC-20260315-42) — includes timeline, commands run, affected customers, and proposed action items.

aj: Action items I added to TKT-4521:
- Audit per-customer autoscaler quotas and failing path (owner: infra-team).
- Add a guard in autoscaler to surface quota-blocked scaling (owner: serving-runtime).
- Improve runbook section: explicit rollback steps for routing.
- Schedule 45m retrospective next Tue 14:00 UTC (calendar invite created).

maria_g: Leaving one more note: we saw a single pod in nodegroup-a oomkill history — possible contributor. I put pod id and logs in the ticket.

aj: I'll keep primary until 19:40 UTC, then hand back to @maria_g unless incident resurfaces. I'm also adding a grafana panel to TKT-4521 for kv_cache_evictions and per-customer throttles.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress — error rate decreased by 68% in last 15m. Status: mitigated (partial).

charlie_ops: CS update sent to affected customers with mitigation details and ETA for full resolution.

ops_manager: Quick reminder — please add blameless language in the retro and include concrete rollout guardrails for model fallback changes.

aj: Will do. Leaving final handoff note (if anyone picks up after me): watch for recurring 504s and elevated redis eviction rates; if they reappear, escalate to infra oncall and open a hotfix to lower connection concurrency for affected customers.

maria_g: Back on primary. Looks stable for now. Thanks for handling the handoff.

aj: np. Closing thread here — follow-up ticket TKT-4521 will track next steps and retro. :eyes:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated): INC-20260315-42 — root cause pending investigation.
